data.professional_title: Senior Business Analyst | BFSI & Capital Markets
data.summary: Results-driven Senior Business Analyst with 13+ years of BFSI experience specialising in trade surveillance, corporate actions, fixed income, derivatives, and regulatory compliance across Tier-1 investment banks (HSBC, UBS, BNY Mellon). Proven track record in reducing manual processing time, improving data quality, and delivering large-scale surveillance model rollouts end-to-end. Proficient in Agile/Scrum, SAFe, SQL, XML/JSON data transformation, Dremio, Cucumber BDD, and ELK Stack monitoring. Skilled at bridging business stakeholders and technology teams to deliver measurable, compliance-aligned outcomes under MiFID II, MAR, and EMIR frameworks.

responsibilities: Led end-to-end feed onboarding for 10+ trade surveillance models, owning data discovery, XML-to-tabular field mapping, and feed completeness governance — reducing new model onboarding cycle time by ~30%.

Authored and maintained BRDs, XML-to-2D mapping specifications, SLA matrices, and UAT test plans; served as single point of contact between the Data Pod and MARS (model execution) teams, cutting requirements rework by 40%.

Defined and enforced data quality and completeness rules across PTS to DSL to tabular pipeline, proactively identifying and resolving feed gaps before model execution — improving upstream data accuracy by ~25%.
Designed and maintained ELK Stack (Elasticsearch, Kibana) dashboards to monitor feed SLAs in real time, enabling detection and resolution of 95%+ of feed failures within agreed SLA windows.

Facilitated Agile ceremonies (daily stand-ups, sprint planning, backlog refinement, retrospectives) across a cross-functional team of 12, consistently delivering sprint goals with fewer than 5% story carry-overs.
Built and maintained a Cucumber BDD regression suite validating surveillance model outputs post-release, reducing post-deployment defects by ~35% over two release cycles.
Collaborated with global stakeholders across UK, US, and Asia on product roadmap prioritisation and regulatory alignment under MAR and MiFID II surveillance obligations.
Managed mandatory corporate action processing for UBS Swiss booking centre, achieving 99.5%+ event accuracy and on-time notification SLA across equity, fixed income, and structured product events.

Identified that ~55% of client notifications were dispatched late (Project Mount Everest / CAIP Renewal); led cross-functional process reengineering to release notifications within 24 hours of SWIFT receipt, directly reducing client-impacting breaks.

Delivered a SharePoint automation initiative cutting payment processing downtime from 120 minutes to under 30 minutes, saving approximately 5 hours of manual effort per month with zero impact on service levels (LEAN project).
Received formal recognition from the Managing Director for a robotics/automation solution subsequently scaled across multiple teams due to its reusability.
Performed root-cause analysis on reconciliation breaks across SWIFT message flows and desktop data feeds; reduced recurring break volume by implementing targeted data validation controls.

Delivered full BA lifecycle across multiple change requests: requirements elicitation, BRD/FRD authoring, UI mock-ups (Figma), feasibility and impact analysis, UAT coordination, and post-implementation sign-off.
Gained on-site experience in Zurich managing mandatory corporate actions and income events, strengthening cross-border operational knowledge for the Swiss booking centre.

experience.company: BNY Mellon India International Operations Pvt Ltd
responsibilities: Notified and processed mandatory and voluntary corporate events (DTC, Bloomberg) for US and global custody clients with a 99.9% accuracy target; consistently achieved SLA in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment.
Ran three time-critical intraday reports (DTC Announcement, Bloomberg Global, DTC Update) to capture new events and updates, ensuring zero missed announcements across the client portfolio.

Contributed as BA on the CANRS (Corporate Action and Notification Response System) project — a real-time DTCC and Bloomberg integration that eliminated manual announcement delays and improved notification accuracy to 99.9%.
Delivered key BA artefacts: BRDs, use cases, UI mock-ups, traceability matrices, MT 202/210 cash processing specifications, and functional test cases for end-to-end system validation.
Managed client elections, broker confirmations, and payment allocations (Full Redemption, CMO Final Payment, Mergers), maintaining payment accuracy and timeliness standards for institutional clients.

education.institution: M.U.C.C College of Commerce, Savitribai Phule Pune University
